items.label: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry quarterly results summary: Q2 results for the fiscal year ending November 2026 (07-09-2026)
items.signal_prefix: In the Electronic Materials business the company says it is accelerating development

set.signal: In the Electronic Materials business the company says it is accelerating development of leading-edge semiconductor materials and expanding photoresist materials into new applications; in H1 it agreed a capital and business alliance with Sanbo Chemical Laboratory (written SANBO CHEMICAL IND. CO., LTD. in the company's English filings) to combine both companies' high-purification technology and development / manufacturing bases in semiconductor and electronic materials.

items.reason: The source names the partner 株式会社三宝化学研究所 (三宝 = Sanbo); 'Sanpo' is a mis-romanization. The company's own English TDnet results summary (10-09-2026) writes the same partner SANBO / SAMBO CHEMICAL IND. CO., LTD., so the entry is aligned to that spelling.
items.evidence: 当中間連結会計期間において、株式会社三宝化学研究所との資本業務提携に合意いたしました。
